level_notes: This is a plan, not a ranking: the tiles are phases. Start here = tests + the daily 10 minutes. Each later phase adds a few drills; the Goals track says what 'done' looks like. Nothing should hurt in the joint — a pinch in the front of the hip means back off and use a block.

skills.name: Goal 0 · Baseline: photos + Thomas test
skills.how: Lie on a table edge, hug one knee, let the other leg hang — does the thigh stay down? Photograph squat, cross-legged sit and forward fold too.
skills.goal: Everything else is measured against this.
skills.dose: Once now, then the first weekend of every month.

skills.name: Goal 1 · Hip hinge to horizontal with a flat back
skills.how: Dowel along the spine touching head, upper back and tailbone; push the hips back until the torso is near parallel.
skills.goal: Proves the hips move before the back does — the base of everything.

skills.name: Goal 2 · Seated fold, hands past the ankles
skills.how: Legs straight, hinge from the hips, reach.
skills.goal: Hamstring range for sitting, bending, picking things up.

skills.name: Goal 3 · 90/90 sit, upright, hands off, both sides
skills.how: Front shin and back shin both at 90°, sit tall without hands on the floor.
skills.goal: External + internal rotation — the two ranges tight hips lose first.

skills.name: Goal 4 · Couch stretch 2 min, tall, no arching
skills.how: Back knee down, rear foot on the couch, glute squeezed, ribs down, torso upright.
skills.goal: Hip flexor length — the desk-sitting muscle.
skills.dose: Test: 2 min per side, breathing normally.

skills.name: Goal 5 · Sit cross-legged 5 min, knees below hips
skills.how: On a folded blanket first, then flat on the floor; no hands, no leaning back.
skills.goal: The everyday one — floor sitting without pain.

skills.name: Goal 6 · Deep squat, heels down, 30 s → 2 min
skills.how: Feet shoulder width, heels flat, sit all the way down and rest there.
skills.goal: Hips + ankles + knees together — the resting squat is the whole system working.
skills.dose: Test: 30 s first, then build to 2 min.

skills.name: Goal 7 · Pigeon with the shin near parallel, chest up
skills.how: Front shin across the mat approaching parallel to the front edge, hips level, no block.
skills.goal: Full external rotation — the stretch-goal version of Goal 5.

skills.name: Goal 8 · Half lotus, comfortable
skills.how: One foot resting on the opposite thigh, both knees down.
skills.goal: The long-game sitting goal; only after Goal 7.

skills.name: The daily 10 minutes (follow-along)
skills.how: Press play, follow along. Beginner routine, no equipment. This is the non-negotiable; everything else is extra.
skills.goal: All of them — frequency beats intensity for tight hips.
skills.dose: Every day, ideally morning or after work.

skills.name: Desk reset: hip flexor routine
skills.how: Alternate this with the daily 10 on desk-heavy days; undoes sitting.
skills.goal: Goal 4.

skills.name: Pelvic tilt awareness
skills.how: Learn to tuck and untuck the pelvis on hands and knees and in half-kneeling. Tight hip flexors hide behind an arched back — this is how you stop cheating.
skills.goal: Makes every hip flexor stretch actually land.

skills.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
skills.how: One knee down, tuck the pelvis, shift forward an inch. Small and honest beats deep and arched.
skills.goal: Goal 4.

skills.name: Glute bridge + hip flexor combo
skills.how: Bridge up squeezing the glutes, then hold one knee to chest while the other hip stays extended.
skills.goal: Goal 4 — tight hip flexors switch the glutes off; wake them up.

skills.name: Couch stretch progressions
skills.how: Start with the foot low on a box, torso forward; progress to foot on the couch, torso upright.
skills.goal: Goal 4.
skills.dose: 2 min per side, after the daily 10.

skills.name: World's Greatest Stretch
skills.how: Lunge, elbow to instep, rotate and reach to the ceiling, hamstring rock-back.
skills.goal: Goals 1, 2 and 4 in one move — the warm-up of choice.

skills.name: Supine figure-four
skills.how: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee, pull the bottom thigh toward you.
skills.goal: Goals 3 and 5 — gentlest glute / piriformis opener, no pinch.

skills.name: Pigeon with props
skills.how: Block or cushion under the front hip so the pelvis stays level; upright first, fold later.
skills.goal: Goals 5 and 7.

skills.name: 90/90 stretch and switches
skills.how: Sit in 90/90, hinge over the front shin, then rotate the knees to switch sides without using hands.
skills.goal: Goal 3.

skills.name: Hip CARs (controlled articular rotations)
skills.how: Standing or on all fours, draw the biggest slow circle the hip can make, everything else still.
skills.goal: Every goal — keeps the range you win.
skills.dose: 3 circles each direction, each side, daily.

skills.name: Internal rotation drills
skills.how: Seated IR lifts, 90/90 back-leg lift-offs — the range nobody stretches and most tight hips lack.
skills.goal: Goals 3 and 6.

skills.name: Butterfly with support
skills.how: Sit on a folded blanket, feet together, blocks under the knees so the muscles can let go.
skills.goal: Goal 5.

skills.name: Adductor rock-back
skills.how: All fours, one leg out straight to the side, rock the hips back toward the heel with a flat back.
skills.goal: Goals 5 and 6 — dynamic and very forgiving.

skills.name: Frog stretch
skills.how: Knees wide on padding, feet turned out, hips sinking back and down.
skills.goal: Goals 5, 6 and 7.
skills.dose: 2 × 60 s; stop at a stretch, never a pinch.

skills.name: Cross-legged sitting: the 3 exercises
skills.how: Adductor length + external rotation drills built specifically for floor sitting.
skills.goal: Goal 5.
skills.prereq: Butterfly with support, Pigeon with props

skills.name: Hip hinge drill (dowel on the back)
skills.how: Dowel touching head, upper back and tailbone; push hips back, knees soft, return by squeezing the glutes.
skills.goal: Goal 1 — teaches the hips to move instead of the spine.
skills.yt_by: How to hip hinge for beginners

skills.name: Seated forward fold
skills.how: Sit tall on a blanket, hinge forward from the hips, hands wherever they land.
skills.goal: Goal 2.

skills.name: Jefferson curl (bodyweight → very light)
skills.how: Standing, chin to chest, roll down one vertebra at a time; add 2–5 kg only when smooth.
skills.goal: Goal 2 — strength through the whole fold so the range sticks.

skills.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
skills.how: Toes ~10 cm from the wall, drive the knee to the wall keeping the heel down; move the foot back as it gets easy.
skills.goal: Goal 6 — most 'tight hip' squats are actually stiff ankles.

skills.name: Supported deep squat
skills.how: Hold a door frame, pole or TRX and sit to the bottom with heels down; let the hips relax there.
skills.goal: Goal 6.

skills.name: Full squat-mobility routine
skills.how: Hips + ankles + adductors in one follow-along built around the deep squat.
skills.goal: Goal 6.

skills.name: Glute bridges
skills.how: Feet flat, drive through the heels, squeeze at the top; single-leg when easy.
skills.goal: Goal 4 — strong glutes let the hip flexors relax.

skills.name: Psoas march (band)
skills.how: Mini band around the feet, lie back, march one knee up against the band while the other leg stays long.
skills.goal: Goal 4 — tight often means weak; a strong hip flexor stops guarding.

skills.name: Horse stance hold
skills.how: Wide squat, thighs toward parallel, knees over ankles — hold and breathe.
skills.goal: Goals 5 and 6 — active adductor strength at the new range.
